actions.intro.processes: Memory and CPU per process, background programs and leak signals. Read-only; ending a process asks for confirmation.
actions.intro.health: Recent critical events, devices with problems, disk health, startup tasks and services, battery and Windows Update. Read-only.
actions.intro.apps: Installed programs, available updates (winget) and Store apps with problems. Only what you select is updated or reset.
actions.intro.network: Adapters, connectivity, DNS and proxy. Network repairs ask for confirmation and respect VPN and organization policies.
analysis.errors: Parts that could not be read:
analysis.unavailable: Analysis not available in this version.
processes.select-first: First select the process in one of the tables above (click its row), then tick "End process" again.
processes.confirm-end:
End "{0}" (PID {1})?

Yes: ask the program to close (it may save work).
No: force it to end (unsaved data is lost).
Cancel: do nothing.
